strengths: Very high attack speed and burst
weaknesses: Short range melee
Slow start before Lunar Blessing
Multi-step boss combo
Evasion/deflection can fail against big hits

name: Twister Amazon
summary: Crit Twister Amazon: Whirling Slash builds whirlwinds and Barrage/Sniper's Mark set up, then Twister on a damage weapon swap shreds packs and bosses. Uses Essentia Sanguis for energy shield leech, so it's fast and deadly but fragile in one-life mode.
gear: Two weapon sets: an attack-speed spear for Whirling Slash and a high-damage crit spear (300+ DPS, Skysliver an option) for Twister. Essentia Sanguis gloves turn leech into ES; stack evasion, ES and capped resistances.
weaknesses: Twisters move randomly and get stuck on terrain
Low effective HP for hardcore
Weapon-swap rhythm to learn

name: Lightning Companions Spirit Walker
summary: Budget bow Spirit Walker: Lightning Arrow and Lightning Rod clear while Wolf Pack, a tamed beast and the Wild Protector bear tank and add damage. Morior Invictus gives a mixed armour/evasion/ES layer, making it one of the safest cheap Huntress bow builds.
gear: Rare lightning bow with a quiver, Morior Invictus body armour for hybrid defences, Guard-effect elemental charms. Voltaic Mark is kept up for mana, not consumed. A mid-budget upgrade path tops out around 20 divines.
strengths: Companions draw aggro and add damage
weaknesses: Mana issues during long boss fights
Lower ceiling than Twister or Stormcaller Arrow setups
Companions need resummoning in hard content

name: Stormcaller Arrow Spirit Walker
summary: Lioneye's Glare bow Spirit Walker that forks Stormcaller Arrows into a Frost Wall for dozens of overlapping explosions, with Primal Bounty feathers adding extra empowered projectiles. A high-end, Mageblood-level showcase with enormous burst damage.
gear: Lioneye's Glare in one weapon set, a wand plus focus swap for Frost Wall; The Brass Dome for armour, Mageblood flasks, high-life ES boots and gloves. Not a starter: the showcase is very expensive.
strengths: Massive burst in a small area
Excellent single target via Frost Wall fork abuse
weaknesses: Very expensive (Mageblood showcase)
Weapon swap and wall placement to master
Damage spikes rely on Primal Bounty timing

name: Beastgunner Crossbow Spirit Walker
summary: Hybrid crossbow and companion Spirit Walker: Crossbow Shot and Armour Piercing Rounds stack bleed and impale while two tamed beasts and the Wild Protector fight under Trusted Kinship. Built and played in SSF, with parry and deflection for defence.
gear: High physical crossbow (The Catha's Balance copies main-hand damage to companions), Idol augments for Idolatry, life and deflection on armour, capped resistances. The showcase reached Mageblood in SSF, but the core works on rares.
weaknesses: Slower clear than pure bow builds
Many companion setups to manage
Niche creator build with little written documentation

name: Glacial Lance Spirit Walker
summary: Crit spear Spirit Walker that throws Glacial Lance and Lightning Spear with Herald of Ice and Herald of Thunder chaining explosions, with Vivid Stampede shocks and Wild Protector bear support. Big numbers, but it needs a high budget to reach them.
gear: High-crit spear with added cold/lightning plus a Sacred Flame offhand, Morior Invictus body armour, Astramentis and Hand of Wisdom and Action for attribute scaling. Valako's Roar charm feeds frenzy charges for empowered lances.
weaknesses: Expensive unique-heavy endgame
Many buttons and spirit skills
Average defences for hardcore

name: Prized Pain Thorns Ritualist
summary: Armour-stacking thorns Ritualist: three Prized Pain rings (thanks to Unfurled Finger) make every melee hit proc thorns, while Volcanic Fissure, Forge Hammer and Stampede supply the hits. Cheap uniques plus The Brass Dome armour make it very tanky.
gear: Nine uniques: 3x Prized Pain, The Brass Dome, Veil of the Night (ignores resistance penalties), Briarpatch, Goregirdle, Dreadfist and a fast mace; starter set costs under 30 exalts. A meme Flame Breath wyvern variant exists on the same chassis.
weaknesses: Needs a full unique set before it works
Slower clear than projectile builds
Thorns scaling caps out at the very top end

name: Infinite Frenzy Glacial Lance Ritualist
summary: Scold's Bridle self-damage is converted to lightning by Lightning Coil, which triggers Valako's Roar for endless Frenzy Charges, so every Glacial Lance is empowered and freezes the screen. Ritualist's charm nodes keep the loop running.
gear: Engine uniques: Scold's Bridle helmet, Lightning Coil body armour, Valako's Roar charm, Bijouborne belt. Physical-damage spear and rings, maximum life on armour, +level of projectile skills on gloves/amulet as the main damage upgrade.
weaknesses: Constant self-damage from Scold's Bridle
Single target is a bit RNG
Loop is gear-gated
Risky in hardcore

name: Splinter Poison Ritualist
summary: Splinter of Lorrata removes the poison stack limit, so flat damage from three amplified rings becomes unlimited poison: Lightning Spear for mapping, Spearfield and Storm Lance for bosses. Melts bosses on modest gear, but plays like a glass ranged spear build.
gear: Core four from level 65: Splinter of Lorrata, Original Sin, Astramentis, Hand of Wisdom and Action. Then stack flat attack damage on all three rings and cover resistances on belt, chest, helm and boots.
strengths: No crit or skill-level stacking needed
weaknesses: Campaign is a struggle before the core uniques
Gear-dependent on rings
Low defences
Weaker against small, mobile bosses

name: Life Stacking Spiral Volley Ritualist
summary: Doomfletch bow Ritualist that stacks around 8k life and three Bursting Decay rings, turning flat physical into huge elemental damage. Spiral Volley maps and Rain of Arrows bosses, with Undying Hate and Defiance of Destiny keeping it alive with no elemental resistances.
gear: Doomfletch locked in weapon set 2 with a damage quiver, Cadiro's Gambit in set 1; life-stacking armour with Greater Rebirth Runes for regeneration to outheal the Bursting Decay drain. Baseline under 30 divines, plus Undying Hate.
weaknesses: Not a league starter
Rain of Arrows struggles against mobile bosses
Cannot scale crit
Relies on Undying Hate and Defiance of Destiny

name: Tempest Flurry Ritualist
summary: Late-endgame quarterstaff Ritualist: Tempest Flurry and Tempest Bell with double heralds, scaled by three amplified rings and Headhunter. One of the strongest melee setups of 0.5, but a mirror-tier showcase rather than a starter.
gear: Elite crit quarterstaff, Headhunter, three high-end rings (one Kalandra's Touch) amplified by Mystic Attunement, Morior Invictus and Astramentis. Showcase PoB is mirror-tier; there is no budget version.
weaknesses: Extremely expensive
Melee with modest defences
No documented league-start path

name: Frostbolt Loop Witchhunter
summary: Frostbolt with Breachlord's Amalgam returns through Mirror of Refraction mirrors, multiplying into a self-sustaining projectile loop that clears with almost no input. Weapon Master snapshots the damage tree on one weapon set and the defence/cooldown tree on the other, behind a huge Sorcery Ward and capped deflection.
gear: Weapon set I is Widowhail bow + Drillneck quiver for the snapshotted Frostbolt damage; set II is an Atziri's Rule staff for the mirrors. Evasion gear (Hyrri's Ire) feeds an 8-10k Sorcery Ward; aim for >85% cooldown recovery, >60% projectile speed, 2k life and 1k mana.
strengths: Near zero-button mapping and AFK Simulacrum
Sorcery Ward takes all hit types after Ceremonial Ablution
weaknesses: Loop resets in instanced boss rooms
Slow mapper by the creator's own admission
Breakpoints (CDR, projectile speed) are fiddly
Needs another build to level; online only after gearing
Damage over time still punches through the Ward

name: Blood and Steel Witchhunter
summary: Armour Piercing Rounds breaks armour and spreads bleed for Herald of Blood explosions, then High Velocity Rounds applies Riven so Fragmentation Rounds shreds bosses. Pitiless Killer plus Myris Uxor and Horror's Flight push the cull threshold so far that most packs die instantly.
gear: Rampart Raptor for the Fragmentation Rounds weapon set, and a high physical DPS crossbow (650+ pDPS for T1-13, 850+ for juiced T15-16) with +projectile levels and leech for the main set. Myris Uxor, Horror's Flight and a 25% cull-threshold Heart of the Well drive the culling; the rest is armour/evasion with resists and life.
strengths: Huge cull threshold: magic and normal monsters die at full stacks
Good bossing via Riven + Fragmentation Rounds
Creator has kept it updated since 0.1
weaknesses: Needs a high physical DPS crossbow
Three armour slots locked to uniques
Boss rotation (APR > HVR > Frag) takes practice
Obsessive Rituals halves armour/evasion once Ward breaks

name: Culling Dragon Witchhunter
summary: Stacks culling threshold past 400% so His Vile Intrusion and Devour can instantly execute and teleport through packs, while a Wyvern Oil Barrage weapon set handles single target. Weapon Master-style two-builds-in-one play behind a large Sorcery Ward and 95% deflection.
gear: Crossbow grenades to level 14, Rend to 31, Oil Barrage to maps; then a crafted His Vile Intrusion staff for the culling/mobility set and a separate single-target set. Myris Uxor and Horror's Flight scale the threshold; full evasion gear for Sorcery Ward and 95% deflection (~110k EHP on the creator's lvl 98).
strengths: Extremely fast clear: execute-teleport through whole packs
Creator pushed it to level 96 in hardcore
Flexible single target (Oil Barrage, Flicker Strike, Fragmentation Rounds)
weaknesses: Culling only comes online in maps after Horror's Flight
Single target is weak on a budget
Unusual mobility takes practice
Several build swaps while levelling

name: Glacial Bolt Tactician
summary: Glacial Bolt raises ice walls that Verisium Manifestations, Pounce wolves and Siege Cascade shatter automatically for large explosions, while Right Where We Want Them pins everything in place. Iron Reflexes armour (~78% reduction) with Polish That Gear deflection makes it one of the sturdier crossbow setups.
gear: Crossbow with high flat physical/cold/lightning and attack speed; full armour gear (Iron Reflexes converts evasion) with life and resists. KingdomTwelve's high-end variant adds The Last Lament, The Coming Calamity and Constricting Command for triple heralds.
strengths: Ice wall explosions clear whole screens
~33k armour and 65% deflect on a mid budget
Simple to play once walls auto-break
weaknesses: Ice walls can block your own pathing
Needs Verisium Manifestations and enough Ward to proc it
Mana hungry if you add Hailstorm Rounds
Swap skill: levels as Galvanic Shards

name: Armour Piercing Rounds Tactician
summary: Physical crossbow hybrid: Armour Piercing Rounds shreds armour while Supporting Fire, Artillery Ballista and Mirage Archer High Velocity Rounds add damage. Pin lock from Suppressing Fire and Right Where We Want Them keeps enemies helpless.
gear: Highest physical DPS crossbow you can afford with attack speed; armour gear with life and resists. Late game adds Heart of the Well, Megalomaniac and Prism of Belief jewels.
weaknesses: Small creator; less community testing
Only an armour layer for defence
Many buttons (APR, HVR, ballista, reload)

name: Bannerman Shield Tactician
summary: Mace-and-shield melee Tactician: Earthshatter and Resonating Shield break armour and pin, while Whoever Pays Best lets you stack War, Defiance and Dread Banners and Harbinger of Madness turns kills into exploding apparitions. A tanky block/armour off-meta option.
gear: Sadist's Mercy mace with a shield, The Brass Dome for armour, Vestige of Darkness and Grip of Kulemak to raise enemy power and damage taken, Sine Aequo for pin buildup. Armour, block and life everywhere else.
strengths: Banner stacking gives big damage and defence auras
Pins everything with Right Where We Want Them
weaknesses: Single small creator source; little community testing
Expensive unique-heavy endgame
Melee range in a ranged-leaning class
Banner juggling adds buttons

name: Arc Totem Gemling
summary: Spell Totems cast Arc chaining up to 30 times off-screen, with Ancestral Bond doubling totem count and paying for them with Spirit. Low-life Mind Over Matter mana stacking (5k+ mana, Archmage) scales the damage; play is drop totems and walk.
gear: Level as grenades and swap around level 65-70 once Ancestral Bond is reachable. Wand/sceptre with spell levels and mana, max mana and crit everywhere; Ky lists setups from a few divines up to mirror tier.
strengths: Very low input, no cast slowdown
Scales from cheap to mirror tier
Strong boss damage from stacked totems
weaknesses: Can't be levelled as Arc Totem; swap at 65-70
Low life (~1.6k) relying on mana: bad for HC
Needs ~5k mana before it feels safe
Chaos resistance often low

name: Glacial Bolt Gemling
summary: One-button crossbow build: Glacial Bolt ice walls are shattered automatically by Verisium Manifestations minions, Pounce and Cast on Elemental Ailment with Biting Frost, for screen-wide explosions. Life/armour Gemling with Virtuous Barrier and Gem Studded; handles all content on a modest budget.
gear: Level with grenades and swap to Glacial Bolt around 70-80 (a risky level-60 swap exists). Needs Verisium Manifestations and ~200 Runic Ward to summon reliably; crossbow with flat damage and attack speed, life/armour gear. Mageblood/Headhunter versions exist for the high end.
strengths: Truly one button once walls auto-break
Several budget tiers documented with PoBs
weaknesses: Unplayable without Verisium Manifestations + enough Ward
Late transition (lvl 60-80)
Walls can block movement in tight maps

name: Despair Doom Blast Gemling
summary: True one-button curse mapper: Despair with Impending Doom, Cursed Ground and Spell Cascade constantly re-curses areas so Doom Blast detonates everywhere. Low-life Archmage crit scaling on 5k+ mana pushes Despair to level 39; glassy by design.
gear: Wand + focus with curse/spell levels, mana and crit; Morior Invictus and balanced red/green/blue supports so all three Gem Studded bonuses are active. Headhunter makes it an autobomber; leveling path is not documented by the creator (grenade leveling assumed).
strengths: Excellent juiced-map clear (200% Delirium, Breach, Abyss)
weaknesses: Low EHP and low-life play: poor HC fit
Not a pinnacle-boss deleter
Many hidden mechanics to set up (gem colours, reservation)
Expensive to make tanky

name: Shield Wall Poison Gemling
summary: Tanky shield melee: Shield Wall segments blown up by Infernal Cry and Fortifying Cry stack poison and bleed, while Resonating Shield and Herald of Blood/Plague clear packs. Armour, evasion, block and Crimson Assault on a Gemling base that scales defence and damage together.
gear: Mace and high-armour shield, armour/evasion gear with life and resists. Icefang Orbit gives the cold/poison identity in endgame; the creator's level-100 version adds Mageblood, Morior Invictus and Kalandra's Touch but none are required.
strengths: Damage and defence scale together off the shield
weaknesses: Damage ramps up slowly early
Shield Wall can feel clunky in tight corridors
Gear progression matters for poison stacking
Unusual playstyle

name: Undertaker Zombie Gemling
summary: Minion swarm of 50+ Zombies and Unearth bone constructs, fed by a Skeletal Cleric sacrifice loop that generates power charges. Levels as a Tactician with Supporting Fire and swaps to Gemling around level 70; Iron Reflexes armour and Uhtred's Chalice keep the player safe.
gear: Purity sceptre for free supports, ~440 spirit for 10 Skeletal Clerics and auras, ~150 Runic Ward for Uhtred's Chalice, 70%+ armour; balance support colours for Gem Studded. Level as Tactician (Supporting Fire) and respec into Gemling around 70.
strengths: Huge minion swarm handles 200% Delirium and Expedition
Player stays back behind the army
Full levelling guide with progressive PoBs
weaknesses: Requires a class respec (Tactician to Gemling) around level 70
Many spirit/support-colour constraints
Single target lower than top builds
Lots of minion micro-setup

name: Chaos Ignite Crossbow Gemling
summary: Incendiary Shot ignites with Searing Flame, and Cast on Elemental Ailment triggers Contagion to spread chaos across whole packs. Iron Reflexes armour Gemling with Blackflame for big ignite damage.
gear: Rampart Raptor or a rare crossbow with flat fire, Blackflame ring for ignite scaling, Enfolding Dawn body armour; armour gear with life and resists for Iron Reflexes.
strengths: Contagion spreads damage across entire packs
Ignite damage ignores many hit-based boss mechanics
weaknesses: Single creator source
Ignite ramp is slower on bosses than burst builds
Blackflame is a key item

name: Elemental Storm & Solar Orb Stormweaver
summary: Tempest Caller triggers Elemental Storm on spell crits while Solar Orb, Orb of Storms, Firestorm and Living Bomb are dropped on packs to keep crits and infusions flowing. Mathil league-started this placed-orb elemental crit caster in Forbidden Rites.
gear: Wand/staff with +levels to spells and spell crit, then crit chance/multiplier and cast speed on rares; Prism of Belief for an extra gem level. No build-enabling uniques.
strengths: Elemental Storm procs automatically from spell crits
Orbs cover the screen while you keep moving
No mandatory uniques; proven league start
weaknesses: Many placed skills and buffs to maintain
Rare-based defences only; squishy in HC
Damage falls off hard without capped crit

name: Orb of Storms Mana-Stack Stormweaver
summary: Orb of Storms and Spellslinger Lightning Conduit scaled through maximum mana and mana regeneration (Archmage, Mana Tempest, later Indigon), with Force of Will taking part of the damage from mana. Plays Orb of Storms straight from the campaign.
gear: Wand + focus or staff with +lightning/spell levels; stack maximum mana and mana regeneration on ES bases, then an Indigon helmet for the late-game regen-to-damage engine. The mid-game budget version works without it.
strengths: Orb of Storms carries from Act 1 to endgame
Force of Will plus a big mana pool soaks hits
weaknesses: Indigon version is expensive
Everything runs on mana; mana drain or burn is lethal
Placed orbs mean repositioning while mapping

name: Ball Lightning Warp Stormweaver
summary: Throws Ball Lightning into packs, then Lightning Warps onto the balls to detonate the pack, with Archmage and Mana Tempest scaling off a large CI mana/ES pool. An extremely fast, flicker-like mapper.
gear: Wand/staff with +lightning spell levels and cast speed (the key damage stat), pure ES bases with maximum mana; a rare utility belt with resistances and mana replaces Mageblood.
strengths: One of the fastest mappers in the class
weaknesses: Teleports into the middle of packs
CI ES pool with little mitigation
Single target weaker than dedicated bossers

name: Frost Darts Cast on Crit Chronomancer
summary: Snakepit-forked Frost Darts machine gun with Cast on Critical Comet, Time Freeze/Time Snap burst windows and Whispers of Doom double curses. Close to one-button, with very high boss damage.
gear: The Whispering Ice staff, Snakepit in the left ring for fork, Maligaro's Virtuosity and Alpha's Howl; ES/evasion rares with spirit. Starts around 25-30 divines; the Headhunter showcase costs far more.
strengths: Huge single target with Time Freeze windows
Temporal Rift and Phased Form as panic buttons
weaknesses: Snakepit and Whispering Ice define the build
Expensive to start and to push
Guide authors call its ceiling lower than top meta casters

name: Iron Ward Rat Cage Chronomancer
summary: Entangle ignites enemies, Fireflower burns you, The Rat Cage turns that fire into physical damage, and every ignite charges Iron Ward for big physical/fire bursts. Armour, Iron Reflexes, Mind Over Matter and Phased Form make it one of the tankiest Sorceress builds.
gear: The Rat Cage body and Fireflower amulet are mandatory for the self-ignite loop; shield, flat physical damage reduction and over-capped fire resistance on rares. Plays as a normal fire caster until The Rat Cage (~level 55).
strengths: Very tanky: armour, MoM, Phased Form, block
Self-fuelling damage loop, good for Ritual, Breach and Trial of Chaos
weaknesses: Large fire hits and armour break are the main threats
Needs its uniques; does not function before The Rat Cage
Slower clear than meta casters

name: Ember Fusillade Archon Chronomancer
summary: Budget fire crit caster: Ember Fusillade with Orb of Storms lightning infusions, Frost Bomb exposure and Elemental Archon nodes, played from Act 1 into mapping. A smooth trade or SSF starter that needs no uniques.
gear: Staff or wand + focus with +fire/spell levels, spell crit and cast speed; ES bases with life and resistances. All rare gear.
strengths: Smooth campaign with one main skill early
Sands of Time and Apex slows give passive safety
weaknesses: Modest endgame ceiling
Bosses need the Reap swap or Archon timing
Leveling-focused guide; endgame tree less documented

name: Thrashing Vines Plant Chronomancer (CI)
summary: Wildsurge Incantation plant caster: Entangle and Thrashing Vines with Accelerated Growth, Bonestorm for armour break and Cast on Critical Detonate Dead, on a Chaos Inoculation ES base with Phased Form. No djinns, for players who want plants without minions.
gear: Staff/focus with +physical and spell levels plus crit; pure ES bases after the CI swap. From Nothing and Effigy of Cruelty are upgrades, not requirements.
strengths: Plants hit large areas and immobilise
Inevitable Agony and Phased Form add burst and safety
Works in group or solo SSF
weaknesses: Many buttons and setup skills
Early plant leveling is slow; levels on chaos/bone skills
0.5 guide (unchanged in 0.5.5); not seen on the HC ladder

name: Entangle Plant Disciple
summary: Entangle and Thrashing Vines (Wildsurge Incantation) with Thunderstorm for clear, backed by Kelari and Ruzhan djinns and Instruments of Power for staff + focus. Ends on Chaos Inoculation with The Fourth Teaching and Sacred Rituals for very tanky ES.
gear: Staff with +physical/spell levels plus a focus via Instruments of Power; life/armour hybrid until the late CI swap into pure ES bases. Bushwhack boots help early Pin.
strengths: Very tanky late (CI, Fourth Teaching, Sacred Rituals)
Maintained maxroll guide with full leveling
weaknesses: Weak first few acts until Thunderstorm and plants come online
Screen clutter from plants and djinns
Two-button damage rotation

name: Skeleton Army Disciple (CI)
summary: Full skeleton army (Warriors, Snipers, Arsonists, Brutes, Reavers, Storm Mages, Clerics) with Last Gasp, plus a Powered Zealot spectre and Kelari/Navira djinns for Command burst. The army does the damage while you stay back on a CI energy shield pool.
gear: Sceptre/helmet/amulet with +minion skill levels and spirit, pure ES bases after the CI swap (~5k ES); Evergrasping Ring and Time-Lost jewels (Baryanic Leylines) are the main upgrades. lifewithoutpants' variant takes Ruzhan's Trap, The Fourth Teaching and Sacred Rituals instead of Navira.
strengths: Army soaks aggro; very safe and SSF-friendly
Good boss damage from Command skills
No mandatory uniques; strong league starter
weaknesses: Lots of gems and spirit to juggle
Visual clutter
Minion pathing in tight maps

name: Grim Pillars Totem Infernalist
summary: Mana-stacking Archmage caster that drops twice as many Spell Totems (Ancestral Bond), all casting Grim Pillars, with Entangle and Bitter Dead for clear. Mind Over Matter and Eldritch Battery turn a huge mana pool into most of your health.
gear: Rare wand or sceptre with + levels to spells and spell crit, Svalinn for block-triggered casts. Stack maximum mana and Spirit (each totem reserves 75 Spirit) and cap resistances; FunkehChicken's HC version swaps to Iron Reflexes armour and life instead.
strengths: Doubled totems deal heavy single-target damage
Totems pull aggro so you can stay back
Most-played Infernalist spell build that is not CoC Comet
weaknesses: Placing totems makes fast mapping clunkier
Mind Over Matter mana pool is weaker to big physical hits than an ES Lich
Needs a lot of Spirit and mana gear

name: Infernal Legion Beast Infernalist
summary: A tamed rare beast companion with Catha's Brilliance and Infernal Legion burns everything around it, while Oil Barrage spreads flammable ground; Bringer of Flame lets all your damage feed its ignites. Armour plus energy shield, refilled by life regeneration through Zealot's Oath.
gear: Saitha's Spear in weapon set 1 (aggravated bleeding means aggravated ignites) and a rare sceptre with + minion levels and minion life; The Mutable Star body armour with Str/Int armour and energy shield pieces and capped resistances. Minion ailment magnitude on rings.
strengths: No required uniques; works in SSF
weaknesses: Big respec away from the campaign Skeletal Sniper setup
Taming a beast with strong mods takes time and luck
Oil Barrage feels clunky without attack speed

name: Shield Wall Infernalist
summary: Melee slam build that uses a Split Personality jewel to start on the Mercenary side of the tree, stacking armour with Iron Reflexes and detonating Shield Wall segments with warcries. Very tanky, but only comes online once you own Nebuloch and the jewel.
gear: Split Personality jewel to reach the Mercenary armour and shield clusters, Nebuloch mace, The Brass Dome and a high-armour rare shield. Mageblood and Amor Mandragora are the top-end upgrades; cap resistances because Altered Flesh converts hits to fire and chaos.
weaknesses: Not playable until you own Split Personality and Nebuloch
Very expensive
Melee range is riskier in hardcore than casting

name: Coiling Bolts Blood Mage
summary: The Liminal Coil wand grants Coiling Bolts, physical and chaos projectiles that chain through cursed enemies; Sunder the Flesh's 15% base spell crit and a heavy curse setup make it crit constantly. The most common Blood Mage on the HC Forbidden Rites ladder, on a life plus energy shield shell.
gear: Liminal Coil wand (usable from level 65) with a crit or spell focus; Alpha's Howl plus a Spirit body armour to reach about 250 Spirit for curses and auras. Energy shield body armour feeds Crimson Power life; cap resistances and use crit-damage jewels.
strengths: Life plus ES with Grasping Wounds is forgiving
Strong single target with Despair and Vulnerability
weaknesses: Needs the Liminal Coil wand; level with Essence Drain until 65
Spirit-hungry curse setup
Life costs punish casting into nothing

name: Blackflame Ember Fusillade Blood Mage
summary: Blackflame Covenant turns Ember Fusillade into chaos damage, cast by hand and through Cast on Critical with tiny durations so embers fire almost instantly. Blood Magic life costs are paid back by Vitality Siphon leech on a large life pool with Crimson Power.
gear: Rare staff or wand with + levels to fire or all spells, spell crit and cast speed; energy shield body armour for Crimson Power life, life on every slot and capped resistances. Uniques are optional upgrades.
weaknesses: Elemental casters level poorly; level as a chaos Witch first
Blood Magic life costs punish misplays
Crit gear gets expensive

name: Plants & Bone Totem Blood Mage
summary: Budget plant caster: Entangle and Thrashing Vines watered by Thunderstorm under Wildsurge Incantation, with Bonestorm in a Spell Totem for bosses. Blood Mage leech and Grasping Wounds keep a life-based character alive on cheap rares.
gear: Rare staff with + levels to physical or all spell skills and spell damage; life and resistances on every other slot, cast speed on rings. The listed uniques are optional comfort pieces.
strengths: Same plant skills carry the whole campaign
weaknesses: Wildsurge's short durations punish sloppy placement
Life costs drain you when casting into empty space
Boss damage lower than crit-trigger builds

name: Wardbound Minions Lich
summary: Runic Ward and mana-stacking Lich that spends its ward to summon temporary Wardbound casters spitting cold spells, backed by permanent skeletons and Pain Offering. Necromantic Conduit and Blackened Heart give everyone Unholy Might scaled by your maximum mana.
gear: Rare sceptre with + minion levels, Spirit and mana; maximum mana and energy shield on armour (Eldritch Battery converts it to mana), capped resistances. Atziri's Splendour and Megalomaniac are late upgrades.
strengths: Minions plus mana stacking in one build
Wardbound casters chill and freeze packs
Unholy Might for you and the army
weaknesses: Niche build with little guide material
Many minion and utility buttons
Lower effective HP than a standard ES Lich

name: Lightning Warp Lich
summary: Speed-farming caster that teleports onto Ball Lightning with Lightning Warp while Ice Nova and Cast on Critical Spark clear around you; Price of Power and Infusion of Power keep power charges flowing to refill mana. Mind Over Matter and Eldritch Battery make mana the main health pool.
gear: Wand and focus with spell levels, cast speed and spell crit; maximum mana and energy shield everywhere and mana cost efficiency on rings. Myris Uxor plus Heart of the Well culling enable the flicker-warp final setup.
strengths: One of the fastest map clears in the game
Mana refills from consumed power charges
weaknesses: Complex to set up and to play
Warping into packs is risky in hardcore
Mana Siphoning monsters are dangerous

name: Cast on Crit Comet Lich
summary: Spark, Arc and Firestorm crit constantly to fire Comets through Cast on Critical, and Price of Power spends power charges for 40% more spell damage. Unlike the CI Infernalist version it sits on a large energy shield pool with Eternal Life and Soulless Form.
gear: Wand or staff with + levels to spells, spell crit and cast speed; energy shield on every armour slot with capped resistances, and Spirit for Cast on Critical, Archmage and Charge Regulation.
strengths: Screen-wide clear with Comets raining down
ES shell is far safer than the CI Infernalist variant
weaknesses: Needs high crit before the trigger loop works
Many skills to manage
Little written guide material for the Lich version

name: Cast on Crit Bone Cage Abyssal Lich
summary: Endgame evolution of the plant Abyssal Lich: Entangle, Thrashing Vines and Thunderstorm crit constantly to trigger Bone Cage through Cast on Critical, with Bonestorm for bosses. Same huge energy shield and Eternal Life shell; Reap is a common alternative trigger.
gear: Rare staff with + levels to physical spells, spell crit and extra lightning damage; Atziri's Disdain helmet and Nightscale gloves (crit-gated mana regeneration), energy shield on every slot and crit-damage jewels.
strengths: One of the tankiest crit casters on the HC ladder
Bonestorm and Bone Cage share the same physical scaling
weaknesses: Abyssal Lich needs a Kulemak kill; play regular Lich until then
Trigger loop only works once crit chance is high
Crit gear and jewels get expensive

name: Oil Barrage Martial Artist
summary: Talisman Oil Barrage that spends Power Charges to fire chaining, forking nova projectiles for screen-wide clear and heavy single-target. Charges come from Rend, Devour and Way of the Stonefist, and the defences are energy shield, evasion and deflection.
gear: Spiny Talisman with 300+ elemental DPS early and 490+ with 15% crit late, plus Power Charge on Crit gloves turned into Fists of Stone. Fill the rest with ES/evasion hybrid armour, resistances and rarity. Hollow Palm Technique is only for the campaign.
weaknesses: Don't-get-hit playstyle
Channel delay until skill speed is scaled
Lots of buttons to maintain charges

name: Herald Whirling Assault Martial Artist
summary: A plain quarterstaff Whirling Assault (no Hollow Form) whose kills set off Herald of Ash or Herald of Ice explosions across the screen. Tempest Bell and Charged Staff handle bosses, and a cheap SSF-friendly path makes it a good league start.
gear: 550+ physical DPS quarterstaff with 15%+ crit, or Ailith's Chimes/Power Charge on Crit gloves. Wear hybrid ES/evasion armour and movement speed boots, and cap resistances. Hollow Palm Technique is used only for levelling.
strengths: Huge AoE clear from Herald chains
Fast SSF campaign, no mandatory uniques
weaknesses: Don't-get-hit melee
Bossing weaker than Hollow Form variants
Herald clear weakens against high ailment threshold

name: Frozen Thunder Flicker Strike Martial Artist
summary: Whirling Assault and Concussive Runes keep Herald of Ice and Herald of Thunder chaining across the screen, and Flicker Strike handles bosses using Power Charges from Martial Master. A strong but gear-hungry endgame build with energy shield and evasion.
gear: A cold and lightning quarterstaff with crit and +3 attack skills, War Wraps with flat elemental damage (turned into extra damage by Stonefist), and Polcirkeln to shatter chilled enemies. Morior Invictus and Mageblood are the high-budget pieces.
weaknesses: Several key items needed to hit its sweet spot
Herald chains weak against high ailment threshold
Flicker throws you into packs (risky in HC)

name: Shattering Palm Requiem Martial Artist
summary: Crit cold mapping with Shattering Palm, Ice Strike, Midnight Zenith and Herald of Ice freezing and shattering whole screens. For bosses it swaps to The Last Lament crossbow and fires Requiem behind War Banner and Tempest Bell.
gear: A cold crit quarterstaff for mapping and The Last Lament crossbow on weapon swap for Requiem. You need at least 50 Spirit on the body armour to run Herald of Ice, Elemental Conflux, Wind Dancer and War Banner.
strengths: Deletes pinnacle bosses with Requiem swap
weaknesses: Boss burst depends on a timed rotation
Less evasion than other Monk builds
Written for 0.5.1, so check numbers for 0.5.5

name: Explosive Shot Invoker
summary: Crossbow Explosive Shot sets off stacked Explosive and Cluster Grenades for big AoE bursts, and Ratha's Assault keeps the reloads coming. Invoker adds extra lightning and cold damage and crits that ignore resistances, with evasion and Wind Dancer for defence.
gear: Any elemental crossbow with attack speed and crit works, and you don't need high physical DPS. Wear an evasion/ES body armour for Lead me through Grace Spirit, and Polcirkeln to shatter frozen packs.
weaknesses: Must dodge while reloading
Crossbow monk is off-class early
Grenade placement takes practice

name: Werewolf Herald Invoker
summary: Werewolf Lunar Assault on a talisman, with Concussive Runes keeping Herald of Ice and Herald of Thunder chaining through packs. Chaos Inoculation, Crystallised Immunities, high evasion and deflection make it one of the tankiest Monks.
gear: A Spiny Talisman with lightning damage, crit and +3 attack skills, and War Wraps with flat elemental. Use a Runeforged helm that allocates Crystallised Immunities, Polcirkeln for shatter chains, and an ES/evasion body for Lead me through Grace Spirit. Mageblood is an optional late upgrade.
weaknesses: Single-target needs a werewolf combo rotation
Several items needed to reach its sweet spot
Herald chains suffer vs high ailment threshold maps

name: Falling Thunder Archon Acolyte
summary: Quarterstaff Falling Thunder turned into chaos damage, with Purple Flames from Into the Breach and burst windows from Archon of Chayula. Shattering Palm and Whirling Assault build combo and charges for a screen-wide one-button feel.
gear: A crit quarterstaff with elemental damage, Original Sin for the chaos conversion and Maligaro's Virtuosity gloves for crit. Evasion/deflection gear with capped resistances; chaos resistance gets doubled by Chayula's Gift.
weaknesses: Archon needs the endgame Breach questline
Evasion-based melee, no big life/ES pool
Charges and combo to manage

name: Chaos Flicker Strike Acolyte
summary: A Mind Over Matter and Eldritch Battery 'drain tank' that flickers around packs and bosses with up to 200% damage gained as chaos from Purple Flames. Power Charges come from Profane Ritual, Esh's Radiance shocks for Herald of Thunder, and Mana Remnants keep it sustained.
gear: Get to 100% crit chance so every Flicker chain crits, plus stun threshold on gear and jewels. Mana and leech are the health pool through MoM/EB; Headhunter and Mageblood are luxury upgrades.
weaknesses: Stun-prone without ES/life
Repulsion and stun-buildup map mods disrupt it
Dies mid-animation if recovery lapses

name: Infinite Herald Statstacker Acolyte
summary: An intelligence stat-stacker using Pillar of the Caged God and Hand of Wisdom and Action. Fragments Of The Past triggers Concussive Runes, which keeps Herald of Ice and Herald of Thunder chaining across multiple screens; one-button mapping with Mind Over Matter and Ward.
gear: Pillar of the Caged God and a matched pair of Hand of Wisdom and Action are mandatory. Stack intelligence to about 1500, plus around 500 Ward on gear for Concussive Runes and crit jewels.
weaknesses: Low defences by the author's own admission
Very expensive, rigid unique gear
Herald of Ice fails in delirium (use Thunder chain)

name: Lifestacker Ignite Acolyte
summary: Rathpith Globe life stacking at 10k+ life scales Fire-Infused Ball Lightning ignites, and Blackflame turns them into chaos. Cast on Elemental Ailment fires Living Bomb, and Red Flames of Chayula leech back huge amounts of life.
gear: Needs Rathpith Globe with the red cultivated life-scaling mod and Blackflame (keep reduced ignite duration under 80%). The rest is flat life everywhere toward 10–16k life. Veil of the Night means no elemental resistances.
strengths: Huge max hit from a 10k+ life pool
weaknesses: No elemental resistances (exploding ground is dangerous)
Rigid, expensive gearing
Flying Expedition monsters dodge ignited ground

name: Infernal Legion Tamed Beast Acolyte
summary: A hybrid companion build where a tamed Gargantuan Wasp with Infernal Legion II (later Catha's Brilliance) ignites everything, spread by your Oil Grenades. Selfless Remnants passes Purple Flame damage-as-chaos to the beast, and evasion, deflection and Ghost Dance keep you safe.
gear: Cheap to start: evasion/ES gear with resistances. Upgrade to Catha's Brilliance and Xoph's Pyre lineage supports, then put From Nothing on Crimson Assault for the companion-life cluster.
strengths: Comfortable with no constant weapon swapping
Strong vs league mechanics with screen-wide oil
weaknesses: Max boss damage needs a multi-button rotation
Less single target than swap variants
Need to capture the right beast

name: Ember Fusillade CoC Oracle
summary: Blackflame Covenant Ember Fusillade plus Cast on Critical Living Bomb and Comet, with Forced Outcome making every hit a crit. A mana-stacking Eldritch Battery / Mind Over Matter caster for mid-to-late endgame.
gear: Runeseeker's Call wand and Dream Fragments ring; stack maximum mana, spell levels and ES on hybrid gear. Mana is the real life pool via Eldritch Battery and Mind Over Matter.
weaknesses: Mana-stacking gear gets expensive
Weak until crit/CoC pieces are in
Many keystones to manage

name: Bonestorm CoC Oracle
summary: Bonestorm channels physical spikes while Cast on Critical fires Thrashing Vines and Thunderstorm off Forced Outcome crits; Entangle plants handle packs. RNGenius's 0.5.5 Oracle that grows straight out of a Bonestorm/plant campaign.
gear: Wand or staff with +spell levels and cast speed; life/ES hybrid armour with capped resistances. No build-enabling uniques; Nightscale gloves and a Heart of the Well jewel are upgrades.
strengths: Same skills from Act 2 to maps
Good boss damage from Bonestorm + CoC
weaknesses: Channelling Bonestorm roots you
Mid-tier defences
Wildsurge shortens plant duration

name: Rend Wyvern Oracle
summary: Wyvern form sweeps screens with Rend and Herald explosions, then dumps Power Charges into Oil Barrage for bosses. Blood Magic life build with armour and block; one of the stronger campaign-to-maps shapeshifters.
gear: Talisman with flat damage and +melee levels; armour/life gear and a shield for block. Morior Invictus and a From Nothing jewel are late upgrades, not requirements.
weaknesses: Power-charge combo for bossing
Blood Magic life costs can bite
Several form swaps to learn

name: Twister Spear Oracle
summary: Spear Oracle that whips up Twisters from Whirling Slash whirlwinds and Barrage, covering the screen in projectiles. Fast and strong but leans on Crown of Eyes, Skysliver and other uniques; CI energy shield with evasion and blind.
gear: Skysliver spear with an empty off-hand for Dance with Death, Crown of Eyes (damage roughly halves without it) and ~6.5k ES for Chaos Inoculation. Optimisation is RNG-heavy and expensive.
weaknesses: Crown of Eyes dependency
Expensive CI transition
Not a league starter

name: Incendiary Crossbow Oracle
summary: Avatar of Fire crossbow Oracle: Oil Grenade ignites ground for clear and Incendiary Shot handles bosses, using Oracle's crit and ailment tools. Iron Reflexes armour on a Blood Magic life base makes it sturdy for a ranged Druid.
gear: Rare crossbow with flat fire/physical and +projectile levels; armour/evasion bases (Iron Reflexes converts) with life and resists. Heart of the Well and From Nothing jewels are late upgrades.
strengths: Fights at range with armour behind it
The Lesser Harm makes enemy hits unlucky
weaknesses: Off-meta; only one creator guide
Reload and grenade cooldown juggling
Avatar of Fire locks you into fire

name: Sunder Rage Totems Shaman
summary: Ancestral Warrior Totems slam Sunder while Shockwave Totem adds AoE, and you sit behind a shield with about 90% physical reduction. POEGuy's one-button, very tanky Shaman, but mid-budget (Redflare Conduit + Flesh Crucible).
gear: Two-handed mace via Giant's Blood plus a high-armour shield; Redflare Conduit (power-charge corruption) and a Resonance Flesh Crucible are mandatory (~70 div entry). Level as Wyvern, then respec.
weaknesses: Not a league starter
Totem placement slows mapping
Mandatory corrupted unique

name: Frostbolt Totem Shaman
summary: Ancestral Bond Spell Totems spam Frostbolt while Frost Wall, Frost Bomb and Thunderstorm set up freezes; Druidic Champion turns Rage into more spell damage. A budget league starter from z3r0pointflux.
gear: Wand/sceptre or staff with +cold spell levels; Snakepit ring early. Hybrid life/ES with capped resists; Megalomaniac and Soul Mantle are late upgrades.
strengths: Totems keep you out of melee
weaknesses: Re-placing totems when moving
Cold-resist map mods hurt
Moderate defences until ES gear

name: Oil Barrage Ice Nova Shaman
summary: Hybrid caster/attacker: Ice Nova and Snap freeze packs and build Power Charges via Infusion of Power, which empower Wyvern Oil Barrage for big single-target hits. Lexyu's low-budget 0.5.5 starter with an evasion/ES endgame.
gear: Staff or Talisman with critical hit chance and +levels; evasion/ES hybrid armour and capped resists. Uniques (Prism of Belief, Headhunter) are late luxuries, not requirements.
strengths: Levels smoothly as the same build
Ice Nova freeze keeps you safe
weaknesses: Multi-button combo and weapon swap
Power charge upkeep for bosses
Evasion/ES weaker than armour builds

name: Shred Werewolf Shaman
summary: Werewolf melee: Lunar Assault and Herald of Ice freeze and shatter packs, then Shred and Cross Slash delete frozen bosses. Reactive Growth/Avatar of Evolution plus armour make it tankier than the Oracle wolf, but Crown of Eyes is a key piece.
gear: Talisman with +max Rage and flat cold/physical; armour/ES hybrid with capped resists. Crown of Eyes and a Controlled Metamorphosis jewel are the big damage pieces; From Nothing late.
strengths: Freeze is a strong defensive layer
weaknesses: Combo timing on Ice Fragments
Crown of Eyes needed for top damage
Melee range vs on-death effects

name: Tornado Spirit Shaman
summary: Rage/Spirit-stacking Shaman sustaining three Tornados that absorb elemental ground for extra damage, backed by Wolf Pack and Temporal Chains/Enfeeble. Off-meta, mapping-focused and expensive.
gear: Spirit-heavy gear (Alpha's Howl, Darkness Enthroned) to run many persistent buffs, ES-focused armour and Runeseeker's Call. Needs substantial crafting to scale.
strengths: Wolf Pack and curses add safety
weaknesses: Expensive and gear-hungry
Mechanically complex
Weaker single target

name: Fervor's Companion Zoo Spirit Walker
summary: Level as a spear Whirling Slash > Twister Huntress, tame Rathbreaker in Act 2 and Mighty Silverfist plus an aura beast in Act 3, then hand the killing to the beasts. In endgame, Sylvan's Effigy removes the companion cap so you field 7+ beasts (Silverfist, Azmerian Wolf, Wolf Pack, Spirit Vessel bear, aura beasts) fed by The Catha's Balance and +minion levels.
gear: Sylvan's Effigy (sceptre) in the off hand. Main hand: Trenchtimbre for the cheap start, then a Chober Chaber corrupted to +4 minion levels, held in one hand via Giant's Blood; its high physical damage feeds The Catha's Balance. Starkonja's Head, and Forgotten Warden (grants Spirit Vessel). Amulet with +3 minion levels. Idols: Idol of Ralakesh (helmet), Primate Idol (sceptre), Fox Idol (body). Everything else: resistances, life, evasion/ES, attributes and some rarity. Anoint Crystalline Flesh. Fervor's total cost was about 20 divines.
strengths: Cheap league start: Fervor ran T15 maps on day 1 with Silverfist, an aura beast and Wild Protector for 0 exalts
You stay back while 7+ companions tank and kill; with Minion Splash, packs die to beast swings
Big damage once scaled: Fervor kills pinnacle bosses in seconds at about 20 divines
Captivating Companionship, Starkonja's Head and Forgotten Warden push part of the damage you take onto companions
The Catha's Balance lets your levelling spear (and later Chober Chaber) feed companion damage
weaknesses: In Fervor's day-1 setup, resistances were only capped while the resistance-aura beast was alive and near you: a big hardcore risk
Fairly small pool for hardcore endgame: about 2k life + 1.4k ES (Giant's Blood halves Strength life)
Needs specific beasts and modifiers (Haste or resistance auras, cheap-Spirit beasts) and a spare Tame Beast gem for re-taming
Heavy Spirit and attribute juggling: Strength for Giant's Blood, Intelligence for sceptres
Clear is slower than self-cast builds, and damage depends on companion AI
Sylvan's Effigy is item level 78 and is farmed (Fervor farms Bodach) or bought; it needs Perfect Jeweller's for sockets

act_plan.companions: None yet. Tame Beast is a level-7 uncut gem, but unique beasts need The Natural Order (Act 2 trial), so save the gem for now.
act_plan.gear: Your spear is everything. Set the loot filter to show all spears and pick them all up: Hardwood Spear, Ironhead Spear (Red Vale), Hunting Spear (Hunting Grounds), Winged Spear (Ogham Manor; may not drop). Craft on the best base with the Runes of Aldur mechanic, and check vendors or gamble if you're stuck. Get life, resistances and evasion on armour, and flat damage on gloves and rings.
act_plan.notes: Fervor calls Count Geonor the hardest boss of the whole campaign. If he goes down easily, the rest is easy. Kite and use Parry > Fangs of Frost > Whirling Slash x3 > Twister on chilled ground.

act_plan.companions: Tame Rathbreaker, the first boss of Act 2 (Vastiri Outskirts). Ctrl+click the zone on the map to open a fresh instance. Cast Tame Beast on him; sparkles show he can be captured. Get him low, recast, then kill him within the roughly 8-9 second window. He is your unique beast until Act 3.
act_plan.gear: Spears: Winged Spear early, then War Spear for damage. Keep the spear upgraded; Fervor killed the Act 2 boss in seconds with a crafted one. Start saving minion gear: helmet, sceptre and amulet with +level of minion skills, sceptre with % Spirit or minion damage.
act_plan.notes: Do the Trial of the Sekhemas (Traitor's Passage) around level 21-22; it is easy for this build. Otherwise, just clear the act normally.

skills.note: Mighty Silverfist from Jungle Ruins, replacing Rathbreaker (only one unique beast at a time). Fervor calls this the big power spike. Supports per poe-vault's Act 3 setup.

Second companion via Trusted Kinship: an aura beast, ideally with Haste aura (Fervor later found a River Drake). A beast with ground effects that Twister can pick up is a fine stand-in. Fervor's Diretusk used Loyalty + Feeding Frenzy I.

Diretusk Boars in Infested Barrens can roll it. Reload instances if you want, but Fervor says not to dwell on it. Always keep a spare Tame Beast gem on you, since each gem works like a Poké Ball.
act_plan.gear: Sandswept Marsh: an elite camp with two elites always drops a Lesser Jewel of War. Fervor used a rare Plague Edge Crossblade Spear he crafted through Acts 3-4. Keep resistances up; start placing Spirit and minion-level pieces.
act_plan.notes: Venom Crypts: Fervor takes the stun-threshold draught (he calls it 'Drop of Stone'). Temple of Chaos: Trial of Chaos for the second ascension. Ignagduk (Azak Bog) gives +30 Spirit and an uncut Spirit gem; poe-vault cuts Wolf Pack with it.

Then farm Bodach (Fervor did Ritual) for Sylvan's Effigy and Forgotten Warden, and grow to about 9 companions: Silverfist, Wild Protector, Azmerian Wolf, Wolf Pack, the Spirit Vessel bear, the Diretusk aura beast, and several crab/chimera aura beasts. Prefer cheap-Spirit beasts.
act_plan.gear: Sylvan's Effigy off hand (item level 78; needs Perfect Jeweller's for full sockets). Chober Chaber corrupted to +4 minion levels in the main hand via Giant's Blood (Fervor: about 1 exalt + vaal, or ~10 ex to buy). Starkonja's Head, Forgotten Warden, amulet with +3 minion levels (his priciest item). Rest: resistances, life, evasion/ES, attributes, rarity. Jewels: minion damage, minion attack speed, crit damage. Anoint Crystalline Flesh.
act_plan.notes: Hardcore: if your resistances depend on an aura beast (as in Fervor's day-1 setup), cap them on gear before pushing red maps. Companions absorb a share of hits (Captivating Companionship, Starkonja's Head, Forgotten Warden), so losing them also lowers your defences. Lifelong Friend speeds up revives.
